reference: unchanged target-specific S3 encoding and existing solver
equivalent_suite_reason: Native Boolean S3-chain encoding changes do not affect the external WDSat S4 executable/corpus. Run matched native systems, exhaustive truth, SAT and F4, plus complete toy DLP attempts.
floor: With reusable fraction f and avoided fraction h, ideal speedup <= 1/(1-f*h), before cache costs. Exact target replay produces no new independent relation.
success: Every assignment set and verified DLP outcome matches baseline; preprocessing template reused on fresh targets. Parameterized route promoted only if setup plus specialization plus complete solving improves total calibrated cost on holdouts.
abandon: Any root loss, spurious relation, unbounded basis growth, or absent amortized benefit blocks promotion; retain timeouts and regressions.

stages.targets: all field values for n<=5; 32 fixed unique values otherwise; even sequence positions development, odd positions holdout

counter_limitations: XOR and conflict counters are partial and not interchangeable. Setup cost included in cold timing. Total calibrated operations, S, rho ratio, floor ratio and exponent are null; no end-to-end speedup claim without calibration and matched verified completions.
redis: Local dedicated Redis for validation; AWS ElastiCache unprovisioned. TTL 86400 seconds, 4 MiB max serialized value, local 32 MiB per thread. Benchmarks use fresh namespaces and cold/new-process replay.
parameter_method: Boolean target bits, never a rational-function parameter field. Compute Boolean Buchberger output once, specialize every target, solve again; check complete root sets against original equations. No claim the specialized output is already a Groebner basis. No lookup table of pre-solved target answers. Experimental only, not enabled in production path.
